cases.description: Test with only whitespace input. The output should be a newline character as all whitespaces are ignored.
Test with a single quoted string. The output should be the same quoted string since it is not affected by whitespace handling.
Test with text surrounding a declaration. The output should replace the declaration with two spaces, and end the declaration with a newline.
Test with trailing whitespace after a declaration. The output should remove the trailing whitespace after the declaration.
Test with multiple declarations. Each declaration should end with a newline, and whitespace should be handled correctly.
Test with a declaration and a quoted string in between. The output should preserve the quoted string and handle declarations correctly.
Test with a declaration at the start and trailing whitespace. The output should handle the declaration and preserve the quoted text.
Test with a single declaration and no surrounding text. The output should have two spaces before the declaration and end with a newline.
Test with text surrounding a declaration without trailing whitespace. The output should replace the declaration with two spaces and end without additional newline.
Test with quoted text before and after a declaration. The output should preserve the quoted texts and handle the declaration correctly.
Test with multiple declarations without surrounding text. Each declaration should be handled correctly, with proper newlines and spacing.
Test with multiple declarations and trailing whitespace. The output should handle the whitespace correctly after the last declaration.
Test with a declaration and quoted text in between, followed by more text. The output should preserve the quoted text and handle declarations correctly.
Test with an empty string input. The output should be an empty string since there are no characters to process.
Test with an incomplete declaration ending with '<'. This should throw a JDOMException due to malformed input.
Test with a declaration that does not have a proper closing sequence. This should throw a JDOMException due to malformed input.
Test with nested declarations. This should throw a JDOMException due to invalid nested declaration structure.
Test with a declaration followed by a quoted string and another declaration. This should throw a JDOMException due to improper structure.
